description: Defines the MacNodeLocationService class, which manages the device's location using CoreLocation. Implements async location requests with timeout handling and conforms to CLLocationManagerDelegate.

classes.name: MacNodeLocationService
classes.description: A service class for obtaining device location asynchronously, with timeout support and delegate handling.

methods.name: currentLocation
methods.description: Requests the current location with specified accuracy, max age, and timeout, returning asynchronously.

methods.name: withTimeout
methods.description: Executes an async operation with a timeout, returning the result or throwing an error if timed out.
